latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* build(deps-dev): bump js-yaml from 4.2.0 to 4.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/pull/1827
* android: fix frame leak with multiple video processors by @HanSeonWoo in https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/pull/1828
* fix(android): guard against duplicate onActivityResult crash in screen capture by @harcorp in https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/pull/1829
* build: ship the vendored declarations in the typescript build by @saghul in https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/pull/1831
* build(deps-dev): bump browserslist from 4.24.3 to 4.28.8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/pull/1836
* build(deps-dev): bump brace-expansion from 1.1.11 to 1.1.18 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/pull/1835
* build(deps-dev): bump js-yaml from 4.3.0 to 4.3.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/pull/1839
* Update WebRTC to M155 by @jallamsetty1 in https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/pull/1846

## New Contributors
* @HanSeonWoo made their first contribution in https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/pull/1828
* @harcorp made their first contribution in https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/pull/1829
* @jallamsetty1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/pull/1846

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/compare/124.0.8...155.0.0
